claims.text: Farin was one of the Dwarves of the Grey Mountains. When his uncle King Dáin I and cousin Frór had been slain by a Cold-drake, his people were forced to flee the dragon-plagued Grey Mountains while he was just 29 years old. Farin's father, Borin, joined Thrór when he rebuilt the Kingdom under the Mountain in .
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk"

claims.text: Farin was the father of Fundin and Gróin, and therefore an ancestor to both Balin of Thorin and Company and Gimli Elf-friend, one of the Fellowship of the Ring.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk"
